blocks.prompt: 2 A farmer bought some sheep for Rs. 9000. If he had paid Rs. 100 less for each, he would have got 3 sheep more for the same money. How many sheep did he buy, when the rate in each case is uniform?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh word problem (ibarati sawal) hai jo pehle rational equation aur phir quadratic equation ban jata hai.
Diya kya hai? Kisaan ne Rs. 9000 mein kuch bheren khareedin; agar har bher Rs. 100 sasti hoti to isi raqam mein 3 bheren zyada aatin.
Find kya karna hai? Kitni bheren khareedin.
Plan: bheron ki tadaad \(x\) maan kar dono soorton mein ek bher ki qeemat likhenge, "Rs. 100 kam" se equation banayenge, solve karenge, aur negative jawab chhor denge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: kul raqam Rs. 9000; Rs. 100 kam qeemat par usi raqam mein 3 bheren zyada.
Humein find karna hai: khareedi gayi bheron ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Roz marra ka usool: ek cheez ki qeemat \(=\) kul raqam \(\div\) cheezon ki tadaad. Misaal: Rs. 100 mein 4 pen, to ek pen Rs. 25. Yahan do soortein hain, dono ki qeemat likh kar un ka farq 100 rakhenge.

Unknown chunein aur dono qeematein likhein
\[\text{Let sheep bought} = x\]
\[\text{price} = \dfrac{9000}{x}\]
\[\text{lower price} = \dfrac{9000}{x + 3}\]
Kyun: Doosri soorat mein wohi Rs. 9000 hain lekin bheren \(x + 3\) hain. Zyada cheezen usi raqam mein aayen to har ek sasti hogi, is liye doosri qeemat chhoti hai.

Equation banayen
\[\dfrac{9000}{x} - \dfrac{9000}{x + 3} = 100\]
Kyun: "Har bher par Rs. 100 kam" ka matlab hai pehli qeemat se doosri qeemat 100 kam hai, yani bari qeemat minus chhoti qeemat \(= 100\).
Dhyan dein: ulta (chhoti minus bari) likhenge to \(-100\) aayega aur sawal ulajh jayega.

Fractions khatam karein
\[9000(x + 3) - 9000x = 100x(x + 3)\]
\[27000 = 100x^2 + 300x\]
Kyun: Har term ko LCD \(x(x + 3)\) se multiply kiya. Pehli fraction mein \(x\) cancel hua aur \((x + 3)\) bacha; doosri mein \((x + 3)\) cancel hua aur \(x\) bacha. Left par \(9000x - 9000x = 0\), sirf \(9000 \times 3 = 27000\) bacha.

Standard form aur factorization
\[x^2 + 3x - 270 = 0\]
\[(x + 18)(x - 15) = 0\]
\[x = 15 \text{ or } x = -18\]
Kyun: Har term ko 100 se divide kiya aur 270 ko left le aaye. Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product \(-270\) aur sum \(3\) ho: \(18\) aur \(-15\).

Na-mumkin jawab chhor dein
\[x = 15\]
Kyun: Bheron ki tadaad negative nahi ho sakti, is liye \(x = -18\) qabool nahi. Word problems mein hamesha dekhein ke jawab haqeeqat mein mumkin hai ya nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{9000}{15} = 600,\quad \dfrac{9000}{18} = 500\]
\[600 - 500 = 100 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 15 bheren Rs. 600 fi bher; agar Rs. 500 fi bher hoti to 18 bheren aatin, yani 3 zyada. Sawal ki dono shartein poori hain.
blocks.final_answer: Us ne 15 bheren khareedin (Rs. 600 fi bher).
